user.title: Connect GroupCal
user.description: Easiest: on a computer, log in at https://app.groupcal.app, open the browser console (F12 → Console), paste the one-line snippet from the integration's README, press Enter, then paste the result into **Setup code**. Or leave Setup code empty and fill in the four fields yourself.

data_description.device_id: The UUID the GroupCal web app generated for this login.
data_description.cm_token: Long-lived SMS verification token. Treat it like a password.
data_description.setup_code: The text the README snippet copied for you. Treat it like a password.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GroupCal
reauth_confirm.description: GroupCal rejected the saved login. Log in again at https://app.groupcal.app, run the README snippet, and paste the new setup code (or fill in the four fields).

data_description.setup_code: The text the README snippet copied for you. Treat it like a password.

error.invalid_setup_code: That setup code isn't complete. Run the snippet again while logged in to GroupCal, or fill in all four fields.

abort.already_configured: This GroupCal account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That login material belongs to a different GroupCal account.

init.title: GroupCal groups
init.description: Choose which GroupCal groups appear as calendars.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach GroupCal to list groups.
